ABOUT THIS READING EDITION

Scripture first. Context alongside.

The reader contains the Authorized King James Version (KJV), with its traditional wording preserved from the identified source dataset. The verse wording is kept separate from study materials and is not rewritten.

Strong’s links identify a Hebrew or Greek dictionary entry associated with a word in the KJV. The contextual note is a study suggestion based on the verse and lexical entry. Strong’s glosses are brief historical definitions; grammar, idiom, textual history, and literary setting matter too. Compare the original entry and judge for yourself.

Bullinger’s Companion Bible notes are bundled locally and linked to their recorded passages. The imported 23,934 Companion Bible note records open in a separate study panel with yellow links beside the verses. The appendices are included in a separate study reader. Bullinger’s interpretations are attributed to him and do not change the Bible text.

Sources: local Authorized KJV word tags from eBible / CrossWire; Strong’s dictionary digitization from Open Scriptures (CC-BY-SA); Bullinger’s Companion Bible notes via SermonIndex. Illustrations are original vector study scenes.
